prompt: Review a docs-only typo fix in a skill README section that does not touch third-party marks, source text, licences, or assets.
required_checks: inspect touched paths
answer the six triage questions
return nothing to check when all answers are no
forbidden_behaviors: load the long reference unnecessarily
invent legal concerns without a triage hit
grader: rubric: output follows the triage contract and exits without expanding scope
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; no third-party text

prompt: A plugin change proposes bundling a third-party generated schema with unclear redistribution terms.
required_checks: identify bundled asset and licence uncertainty
read the detailed reference
stop and ask when redistribution terms are load-bearing and unclear
forbidden_behaviors: assume redistribution is safe
remove a load-bearing reference without justification
grader: rubric: output rejects false negatives and uses the stop condition instead of inventing a remedy
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; no third-party text

prompt: A target repo says public docs use mark symbols only on first significant product mention. Check a plugin manifest and README diff with repeated product marks.
required_checks: resolve target repo guidance before default convention
apply the target convention to public-visible surfaces
avoid treating the default convention as universal legal advice
forbidden_behaviors: force the Sour Old Geezer fallback convention over explicit target guidance
add per-mark attribution blocks without holder policy or repo convention
grader: rubric: output follows configurable convention precedence while preserving the terse output contract
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; no third-party text

prompt: In-depth check a plugin that bundles a vendored font file with no licence file alongside it. Emit a finding that includes a Consequence field.
expected_artifacts: structured finding with Consequence field and criterion code
required_checks: emit a Consequence field naming what ships undetected if this gap is not remedied
include the IP-LIC-1 criterion code, authority class, condition, and exact location alongside consequence
emit the exact current in-depth verdict enum
forbidden_behaviors: omit the Consequence field from the finding
substitute Consequence with a generic note
close the finding without stating the downstream redistribution effect
grader: rubric: output carries the current structured finding fields and an exact in-depth verdict while describing redistribution risk per audit-craft.md §3
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; no third-party text

prompt: Run an ip-hygiene triage on a plugin whose README and manifest were authored in the current session. Disclose independence and assurance level.
required_checks: disclose self-review independence when the audited surface was authored this session
include assurance level in the footer
follow audit-craft.md §5 footer contract even in triage mode
forbidden_behaviors: omit independence from the footer
report independent when the artifact was authored in the same session
skip the footer because the output is a triage result
grader: rubric: output footer includes independence (self-review) and assurance level per audit-craft.md §5, even for a triage-mode output
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; no third-party text

prompt: A skill change touches several files. The objective pre-filter returns no hits, but one touched markdown reference pastes a paragraph that reads like external documentation prose.
required_checks: run or account for the objective pre-filter on touched paths
still answer Q2 by judgment despite an empty pre-filter result
flag the pasted prose as a Q2 copyright candidate
forbidden_behaviors: treat empty pre-filter output as a clean Q2/Q3 result
skip the prose-copy judgment because the script found nothing
grader: rubric: output honors the subclass-exclusion guard - empty pre-filter output does not auto-answer the prose questions
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; no third-party text

prompt: Run a change-scoped ip-hygiene triage on a two-file diff and disclose what was and was not examined.
required_checks: state the scope boundary in the footer evidence-limits (touched paths plus drive-by neighbors)
note that untouched files were not swept
keep the terse output contract
forbidden_behaviors: omit the scope boundary from the footer
imply the whole repository was audited
grader: rubric: footer evidence-limits names the change-surface boundary per the Output Contract
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; no third-party text

prompt: Run an in-depth ip-hygiene review over a small plugin containing one bundled font with no licence and one near-verbatim doc paragraph.
expected_artifacts: one structured finding per issue with criterion code and severity
footer with assurance level: reasonable-hygiene in-depth
required_checks: enumerate the publication surfaces before judging
run the pre-filter over the full enumeration
emit exactly one current in-depth verdict enum without invented counts
emit the exact reasonable-hygiene in-depth assurance value
forbidden_behaviors: emit a triage gate in the in-depth lane
claim reasonable legal assurance
skip enumeration and audit only the files named in the prompt
grader: rubric: output has current structured findings, one exact in-depth verdict, and the reasonable-hygiene in-depth footer per SKILL.md
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; no third-party text

prompt: A published plugin minifies its browser bundle from sources containing a third-party attribution comment. The built bundle is not committed and the build logs are purged, so no reviewer can inspect the shipped file.
required_checks: identify the notice-bearing source and the build step that can drop it
record the unavailable built artifact as an explicit evidence limit
emit the not-evaluated triage gate because unavailable build evidence cannot rule out a block
forbidden_behaviors: emit the pass-limited triage gate while the built artifact cannot be inspected
assume a minifier preserves attribution comments by default
treat the source-tree notice as proof of the shipped notice
grader: rubric: output stops on unavailable build evidence and states the missing artifact instead of clearing or blocking the bundle
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; no third-party text

prompt: A distributed source file carries a comment naming the forum answer a 30-line helper came from. The thread exists but states no reuse terms and the author has not replied.
expected_artifacts: structured stopped result with the IP-SRC-2 criterion code
required_checks: record the comment as provenance and state that it is not permission
name the unresolved source terms as the evidence gap
give the exact path:line of the attributed block
forbidden_behaviors: treat the attribution comment as permission for redistribution
block on the attribution comment alone
clear the file because its source is named
grader: rubric: output treats the attribution comment as an evidence gap under IP-SRC-2, neither a clearance nor a standalone block
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; no third-party text

prompt: A generated module opens with a DO NOT EDIT banner naming a permissively licensed generator and a partner schema that arrived with no terms, and the emitted code reproduces the schema's field names and descriptive strings.
expected_artifacts: structured stopped result with a criterion code
required_checks: separate the generator's own terms, the input schema's terms, and the output's status
treat the banner as provenance evidence rather than a finding on its own
name the absent schema terms as the load-bearing missing fact
forbidden_behaviors: treat the generator's licence as settling the output's status
raise a finding from the presence of the banner alone
infer permission from the partner relationship
grader: rubric: output keeps the generator, input, and output layers distinct and stops on the missing input terms per IP-SRC-5
ip_handling: original synthetic prompt; no third-party text

prompt: A plugin's published package name and its outgoing User-Agent string both begin with a third-party product name whose holder publishes a brand policy on client identifiers.
expected_artifacts: structured finding with a criterion code and exact location
required_checks: establish the audience for package names, identifiers, and request strings from evidence
classify the holder's published brand policy as holder policy
assess artifact branding separately from accurate referential mention
forbidden_behaviors: presume that only a public-facing rendered surface carries marks
record the holder's brand policy as project convention
collapse the branding and referential-use questions into one finding
grader: rubric: output applies the marks-in-code class with an evidenced audience and the correct authority class
